description: Use this when the user names a race they are training for, for example "IRONMAN 70.3 Barranquilla", "I signed up for the half ironman in Cartagena" or "Chicago Marathon". It finds the race in Phorme's race listings (name, date, city and the race's own page), counts the weeks to race day, and returns the week of Phorme's plan for that kind of race that lines up with race day, with sets, reps, paces, coach notes and a demo link for each exercise. For a triathlon (IRONMAN 70.3, 5150, full) it is swim, bike and run in one plan, with efforts until the athlete's swim and bike tests are in. It reads only and changes nothing. If the race is not listed it says so; never guess a race date. Do not use it for injury rehab or nutrition.

race.description: The race as the user named it, for example "IRONMAN 70.3 Barranquilla".
